description: This file implements functions and methods related to Oblivious HTTP header key configuration, including serialization, parsing, validation, and support for different cryptographic algorithms as per the IETF OHTTP specification.

classes.name: ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration for an Oblivious HTTP header key, including methods for validation, serialization, and parsing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ObliviousHttpHeaderKeyConfig instance after validating the provided IDs.

methods.name: ValidateKeyConfig
methods.description: Validates that the key configuration IDs are supported.

methods.name: GetHpkeKem
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_KEM* corresponding to the kem_id.

methods.name: GetHpkeKdf
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_KDF* corresponding to the kdf_id.

methods.name: GetHpkeAead
methods.description: Returns the EVP_HPKE_AEAD* corresponding to the aead_id.

methods.name: SerializeRecipientContextInfo
methods.description: Serializes the context info for recipient, following the OHTTP spec.

methods.name: ParseOhttpPayloadHeader
methods.description: Parses the OHTTP payload header from a string view.

methods.name: ParseOhttpPayloadHeader (overload)
methods.description: Parses the OHTTP payload header from a QuicheDataReader.

methods.name: ParseKeyIdFromObliviousHttpRequestPayload
methods.description: Extracts the key ID from an Oblivious HTTP request payload.
